name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.virtualjoystick
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: The UGUI joystick prefab (background + handle images) with the VirtualJoystick component pre-wired. Drop it under a Canvas and tune stick type, vector mode, axis constraint, movement range, and dead zone.
Demonstrates onStickInput subscription moving a target: Fixed vs Floating stick types, Normalized vs Delta vector modes, axis constraints, and dead-zone filtering.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the VirtualJoystick: VirtualJoystick component setup, onStickInput usage, stick types/vector modes, and the UI prefab. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
